title: Heat plugger: how far does GP soften?
topic: GP hits flow temp (≥60 °C) only ~1 mm past a hot plugger tip; apical GP barely warms and the root surface usually stays under +10 °C (ex vivo). Downpack ~3–5 mm short of WL.

claims.claim: Dial 200 °C, model tip 150 °C: real heat-carrier tips often run below the dial
claims.source: Atmeh AR et al., Int Endod J 2020;53:698-708 (PMID 31955442); Hadis M, Camilleri J, Dent Mater 2020;36:1183-9 (PMID 32505536)

claims.claim: GP reaches flow temp (≥60 °C) only ~1 mm past the plugger tip (model: 0.8 mm)
claims.source: Yu Y et al., J Dent Sci 2023;18:9-16 (PMID 36643252); Briseño Marroquín B et al., J Endod 2015;41:79-82 (PMID 25134732)

claims.claim: Model heat held 1.8 s at depth (simplified; no separation burst)
claims.source: Toy model / schematic: axisymmetric heat-diffusion model tuned at 3 ex vivo anchor points (see NOTES.md)

claims.claim: 2 mm past the tip (plugger at WL−4 mm): only ~4 °C warmer
claims.source: Villegas JC et al., Int Endod J 2005;38:218-22 (PMID 15810971)

claims.claim: Root surface usually under +10 °C at a 200 °C dial (ex vivo)
claims.source: Sweatman TL et al., J Endod 2001;27:512-5 (PMID 11501588); Lee FS et al., J Endod 1998;24:617-20 (PMID 9922753)

claims.claim: Over +10 °C reported in thin roots and in a thermocouple/IR premolar study
claims.source: Lipski M, Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol Oral Radiol Endod 2005;99:505-10 (PMID 15772602); Mc Cullagh JJ et al., Int Endod J 2000;33:326-32 (PMID 11307207)

claims.claim: +10 °C limit (47 °C): 47 °C for 1 min impairs bone formation (rabbit)
claims.source: Eriksson RA, Albrektsson T, J Oral Maxillofac Surg 1984;42:705-11 (PMID 6593442); Eriksson AR, Albrektsson T, J Prosthet Dent 1983;50:101-7 (PMID 6576145)

claims.claim: Below the tip: softened ~1 mm, warm 41–55 °C at 1–2 mm (model), compacted near body temp beyond 2 mm
claims.source: Toy model / schematic peaks, anchored to Yu 2023 (PMID 36643252) and Villegas 2005 (PMID 15810971)

claims.claim: Downpack to ~3–5 mm short of WL (ex vivo adaptation data)
claims.source: Smith RS et al., J Endod 2000;26:668-72 (PMID 11469298); Guess GM et al., J Endod 2003;29:509-12 (PMID 12929697); Zhang C et al., Int Endod J 2011;44:1041-6 (PMID 21906086)

caption:
How far past the plugger tip does gutta-percha actually soften?

Simulated IR view of a continuous-wave downpack (plugger at WL−4 mm):
• GP reaches flow temp (≥60 °C) only ~1 mm past the tip.
• 2 mm past the tip: only ~4 °C warmer (ex vivo canal-wall data).
• Root surface usually stays under +10 °C at a 200 °C dial ex vivo, but thin roots can exceed it.
• Ex vivo adaptation data favour a downpack ~3–5 mm short of WL.

Refs: Yu 2023 J Dent Sci; Briseño Marroquín 2015 J Endod; Villegas 2005 Int Endod J; Sweatman 2001 J Endod; Lipski 2005 OOOOE; Smith 2000 J Endod; Guess 2003 J Endod
Schematic toy heat model, not real thermal footage.
